offers_products.reason: Manufactures nitrogen fertilizers: ammonia, UAN, urea, plus diesel exhaust fluid, CO2 and nitric acid.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from selling manufactured fertilizer and related chemicals, not from work done for customers.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Bulk fertilizer and industrial chemicals go to agricultural and industrial buyers, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells fertilizer to farmers, ag retailers and distributors, plus power, ethanol and industrial users.

recurring_revenue.reason: Farmers and distributors repurchase nitrogen fertilizer every season; consumable input with repeat orders.

cyclical_demand.reason: Nitrogen is an essential annual crop input; farmers can't easily skip it, though prices swing.

big_ticket.reason: Fertilizer is a seasonal, repeatedly bought consumable input, not a large infrequent purchase.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured fertilizer from plants, not staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are farmers, ag retailers and co-ops, and industrial users; not mainly large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates large Coffeyville gasification and East Dubuque nitrogen plants needing heavy ongoing capital investment.

notes: Customer mix is inferred from typical fertilizer markets; the website text doesn't name buyers directly.
